name: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: Hybrid Turbo v3 (int8, 8 steps)
author: Darksidewalker
note: The hybrid with distillation blended in: 8 steps with euler, no turbo LoRA on top, about twice as fast, with the loss of detail any turbo has (his words: turbo is always a quality loss for H3 at the moment). For drafts; the full-steps preset for the final take.

licence.name: MiniMax H3 Community License
